purpose: Add a typed reservoir-confinement-threshold-transport-observable bridge to the existing Climate Engine x Juno comparative shadow without asserting cross-domain mechanism equivalence.

limnic_co2.source: deep CO2 recharge into a stratified lake
limnic_co2.reservoir: dissolved CO2 in dense deep water/hypolimnion
limnic_co2.threshold: local dissolved-gas saturation/exsolution threshold under pressure-temperature-chemistry state
limnic_co2.positive_feedback: ascent lowers pressure -> exsolution -> gas fraction rises -> mixture density falls -> further ascent

planetary_aurora.reservoir: magnetospheric charged-particle population and electromagnetic energy
planetary_aurora.threshold: particle acceleration/precipitation conditions sufficient for atmospheric excitation/ionization
planetary_aurora.transport: charged-particle motion guided/accelerated by electromagnetic fields
